_comment: Button soft component fixture — demonstrates CVA (class-variance-authority) mapping.
_notes: CVA maps are declared in a container's map[] with mode: 'cva'.
'from' is an array of soft field names that drive the variant selection.
'to' targets 'values.className' — a key inside fixedProps.values that gets merged into the element's class list.
cva.base is always applied. cva.variants[] is an array of { fieldId, classes } objects.
- fieldId: which soft field selects the variant row.
- classes: a map of field value → Tailwind class string.
fixedProps.values.className should be pre-computed with the default variant classes so the component renders correctly on first paint.
slotItem inside components{} holds the inner nodes (e.g. the text label inside the button).
Each inner node has its own map[] (mode: 'simple') to receive the text content from the soft prop.
name: Button

components._comment: Root container — drives the button element. CVA map writes to values.className.
